subscriptionPlans.faq1Question: What is the difference between the 3-month and 6-month plans?
subscriptionPlans.faq1Answer: Longer terms pool your download quota across the whole period, so you never have to worry about a monthly renewal.
subscriptionPlans.faq2Question: Is game download traffic billed at half price?
subscriptionPlans.faq2Answer: Yes. All DrGame dedicated download servers are hosted in accredited Iranian data centers and qualify for the 50% half-price traffic discount on every carrier.

gamepad.pageTitle: Online controller health & stick drift tester
gamepad.pageDescription: Connect your DualSense or DualShock controller and check every button, trigger sensitivity and rumble motor.
gamepad.faqTitle: Key notes on controller health testing and fixing drift:
gamepad.tip1Body: If the drift percentage exceeds 15% without touching the sticks, the controller has a faulty potentiometer or internal dust.
gamepad.tip2Body: The rumble test requires browser access (HTTPS) and a wired connection on Windows or macOS.
gamepad.tip3Body: With a healthy Hall-effect sensor or trigger spring, pressing the trigger gently should raise the percentage smoothly from 0 to 100.
